component.subject: Call to Repentance
component.source: 1 John 4:7-8 adapted from the World English Bible (pronouns made inclusive); 1 John 4:20-21 from the Open English Bible, release 2025.6 (US spelling), CC0.

original.p: 1 John 4:7-8 (WEB): Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

1 John 4:20-21 (OEB 2025.6): If someone says ‘I love God,’ and yet hates others, they are a liar. For the person who does not love their brother or sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen. Indeed, we have this command from Christ: Those who love God must also love each other.

block.p: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God, and knows God. The person who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

If someone says ‘I love God,’ and yet hates others, they are a liar. For the person who does not love their brother or sister, whom they have seen, cannot love God, whom they have not seen. Indeed, we have this command from Christ: Those who love God must also love each other.
